# list post

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:listPost`](gmeow-listPost.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/listPost>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The posting address or sentinel for the mailing list this message was distributed through (RFC 2369 List-Post). A datatype property because RFC 2369 permits the sentinel value 'NO' for announcement-only lists; URI values are stored as literals. The raw header is also preserved on [`MessageHeader`](../classes/gmeow-MessageHeader.md).
